items.title: MindTopo: Can Foundation Models Reason in Topological Space?
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial reasoning depends not only on metric properties such as distance, angle, and shape, but also on topological relations that remain invariant under continuous deformation. Cognitive science identifies these relations as foundational to spatial understanding, yet foundation-model evaluations largely focus on metric or viewpoint-dependent relations. We introduce MindTopo, a benchmark of topological intuition across five properties grounded in cognitive science and formal topology: continuity, separation, order, enclosure, and knots. MindTopo evaluates each property at two cognitive levels. Reasoning asks a model to identify topological relations or infer how they change. Planning instantiates a foundation model as a closed-loop agent whose policy selects environment actions. MindTopo contains 11,030 instances across 13 procedurally generated task types with controllable difficulty. We benchmark 14 MLLMs and study agent configurations augmented with image and video generation, including 3 video generative models in planning settings. Every MLLM performs better on reasoning than on planning, and the best-performing model remains far below observed human performance. On Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning improve reasoning more than planning. Generated observations retain local cues and reach plausible endpoints, but audited rollouts do not reliably follow environment dynamics or preserve topology across transitions. Our website is at https://mind-topo.github.io/
items.summary_zh: MindTopo以拓扑不变量为核心，评估多模态模型在拓扑关系识别、变化推断及闭环规划中的表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将连续性、分离、次序、包围和纽结等关系拆为可控难度任务，并报告模型在规划阶段明显更弱；这为检验模型是否保持拓扑约束提供了较具体的基准。
items.abstract_zh: 空间推理不仅依赖距离、角度和形状等度量性质，也依赖在连续变形下保持不变的拓扑关系。认知科学将这些关系视为空间理解的基础，但基础模型评测大多聚焦于度量关系或依赖视角的关系。我们提出 MindTopo：一个覆盖五种、植根于认知科学和形式拓扑学的拓扑直觉性质——连续性、分离、次序、包围和纽结——的基准。MindTopo 在两个认知层面评估每种性质。推理任务要求模型识别拓扑关系，或推断其如何变化。规划任务则将基础模型实例化为闭环智能体，其策略选择环境动作。MindTopo 包含11,030个实例、13类程序生成的任务类型，并具有可控难度。我们评测了14个 MLLM，并研究了由图像和视频生成增强的智能体配置，其中规划设定包括3个视频生成模型。每个 MLLM 在推理上的表现都优于规划，且最佳模型仍显著低于观察到的人类表现。在 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct 上，监督微调和强化学习对推理的改进大于对规划的改进。生成的观测保留了局部线索并能到达看似合理的终点，但经审计的轨迹并不能可靠地遵循环境动力学，或在转变过程中保持拓扑。我们的网站为 https://mind-topo.github.io/。
items.author_line: Yunfei Ge, Anbang Liu, Qineng Wang, Johnalbert Garnica, Jianwen Lyu, Zihan Wang, Reuben Tan, Jianfeng Gao, Ruohan Zhang, Yining Hong, Jiajun Wu, Manling Li

items.title: Magenta: Closing the Loop Between Mathematical Reasoning and Lean Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Most of mathematical knowledge has been communicated through so-called informal use of mathematics and natural language. With large language models (LLMs) being highly adept in using natural language, they achieve strong performance, yet not perfect, in informal mathematical reasoning. Restraining LLMs to informal reasoning misses out on the opportunity to use the discrete verification abilities that machines offer through machine-checkable proofs. In this paper, we bridge the gap between informal and formal reasoning by integrating Lean signals into the informal reasoning process. We introduce Magenta, a training-free agentic pipeline that, given only a natural-language problem, produces an answer, expresses it as a Lean 4 statement, and constructs a machine-checked proof. A statement judge verifies whether the formalisation preserves the original problem, while an error-attribution judge routes failed attempts either to mathematical re-derivation or local Lean repair. Magenta achieves 100% accuracy across all evaluated olympiad benchmarks, including AIME 2025, AIME 2026, and HMMT February 2026. When paired with the open-weight K2-Horizon-7B reasoner, it solves all six IMO 2026 problems. Our analysis shows that statement adjudication is essential for preventing false certificates and that feedback-guided correction outperforms independent resampling on difficult problems.
items.summary_zh: Magenta将自然语言解题、Lean 4 陈述生成和机器检查证明串联，并以陈述核验和错误归因反馈处理失败尝试。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其目标是避免“形式证明通过但陈述偏离原题”的假证书；摘要报告了明确的奥赛评测和 Lean 机器检查，但100%准确率及 IMO 结果仍是预印本作者报告。
items.abstract_zh: 大多数数学知识一直通过所谓非形式化的数学使用和自然语言来交流。由于大语言模型（LLM）非常擅长使用自然语言，它们在非形式化数学推理中取得了很强但并不完美的表现。将 LLM 限制在非形式推理中，会错失利用机器通过机器可检查证明所提供的离散验证能力的机会。本文通过将 Lean 信号整合进非形式推理过程，弥合非形式推理与形式推理之间的鸿沟。我们提出 Magenta：一种无需训练的智能体流水线，仅给定一道自然语言问题，便生成答案，将其表述为 Lean 4 陈述，并构造经机器检查的证明。陈述裁判验证形式化是否保留原问题；错误归因裁判则将失败尝试导向数学重新推导或局部 Lean 修复。Magenta 在所有已评估的奥赛基准上均达到100%准确率，包括 AIME 2025、AIME 2026 和 HMMT February 2026。与开放权重推理模型 K2-Horizon-7B 配对时，它解出了 IMO 2026 的全部六道题。我们的分析表明，陈述裁决对于防止假证书至关重要，并且反馈引导的纠错在困难问题上优于独立重采样。
items.author_line: Joshua Ong Jun Leang, Haonan Li, Zheng Zhao, Xinyi Shang, Wenda Li, Zhengzhong Liu, Erix Xing, Shay Cohen, Eleonora Giunchiglia

items.title: Can LLMs Follow Medical Expert Logic? A Benchmark for Hierarchical Logical Consistency in Risk-of-Bias Assessment
items.abstract_or_text: Evidence-based medicine demands strict logical consistency, yet current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) prioritize superficial label matching over genuine reasoning. We introduce LogiMed-RoB, a benchmark grounded in Cochrane Risk of Bias (RoB) 2.0 expert logic, comprising 860 randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and 14,820 queries. It evaluates models under the Hierarchical Logical Consistency (HLC) framework across four dimensions: Atomic Consistency, Domain Consistency, Aggregation Consistency, and Evidential Faithfulness. Experiments on 10 state-of-the-art LLMs reveal a catastrophic Error Compounding Effect: despite the top model reaching 98.88% Atomic Consistency, its end-to-end consistency collapses to 45.13%, with several open-weight architectures plummeting to nearly 0%. We further uncover a systematic evidence-reasoning gap: even when models retrieve high-quality evidence, they fail to deduce correct outcomes in 18.63-40.05% of cases, while Blind Guess Rates reach 48.28%. LogiMed-RoB demonstrates that high outcome accuracy can conceal critical reasoning flaws, underscoring the necessity of white-box logical verification for clinical deployment.
items.summary_zh: LogiMed-RoB以 Cochrane RoB 2.0 专家逻辑为基础，分层测量模型在偏倚风险评估中的逻辑一致性与证据忠实性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它显示原子层面的高分未必能传递到端到端逻辑结论，因而为评估可审计推理链提供了具体的分层指标；应用领域是医学证据评估，而非数学定理证明。
items.abstract_zh: 循证医学要求严格的逻辑一致性，但当前对大语言模型（LLM）的评估优先考察表面的标签匹配，而非真实推理。我们提出 LogiMed-RoB：一个以 Cochrane Risk of Bias（RoB）2.0 专家逻辑为基础的基准，包含860项随机对照试验（RCT）和14,820个查询。它在分层逻辑一致性（HLC）框架下，从四个维度评估模型：原子一致性、领域一致性、聚合一致性和证据忠实性。对10个最先进 LLM 的实验揭示了灾难性的错误累积效应：尽管最佳模型的原子一致性达到98.88%，其端到端一致性却降至45.13%，若干开放权重架构则降至接近0%。我们还发现了系统性的证据—推理鸿沟：即使模型检索到高质量证据，它们仍有18.63%至40.05%的情形无法推导出正确结果，而盲猜率达到48.28%。LogiMed-RoB 表明，高结果准确率可能掩盖关键的推理缺陷，凸显了临床部署中白盒逻辑验证的必要性。
items.author_line: Jiayu Huang, Zichen Tang, Qianhui Ling, Zemin Kuang, Haihong E

items.title: Beyond Solver Verdicts: Generative Reward Models for Autoformalization
items.abstract_or_text: Neurosymbolic systems rely on mathematical solvers to guarantee reasoning correctness, yet solvers are fundamentally blind to whether a formal translation maintains strict reference-equivalence to a designated formalization. We formalize this vulnerability as Verdict-Preserving-Unfaithfulness (VPU): a failure mode where an incorrect encoding executes successfully and matches the expected verdict. We theoretically prove that structural, verdict-only verification heuristics are mathematically bounded to chance-level detection on these deceptively valid traces. To resolve this, we introduce Generative Verification (GenV), which distills an offline Z3-equivalence oracle into a reference-free, continuous reference-equivalence score by repurposing the language model's native vocabulary space. Mechanistic analysis via decision-projected logit lenses and sparse autoencoders shows this generative readout natively extracts precise spatial error coordinates without explicit localization training. Empirically, our oracle-mined verifier (GenV+HN) achieves 0.961 AUROC in reference-equivalence verification, generalizes zero-shot across unseen translators and divergent formal styles, and yields an 11.3-point downstream accuracy gain in agentic test-time compute allocation.
items.summary_zh: 该工作讨论自动形式化中“求解器判定正确但形式翻译不等价”的漏洞，并以 Z3 等价性预言机蒸馏训练 GenV 验证器。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将形式化正确性从求解器返回的 verdict 扩展到与参考形式化的等价性，并报告跨翻译器的零样本验证结果；所述理论界限和性能均来自预印本摘要。
items.abstract_zh: 神经符号系统依赖数学求解器来保证推理正确性，但求解器从根本上无法判断形式翻译是否与指定的形式化保持严格的参考等价性。我们将这一脆弱性形式化为 Verdict-Preserving-Unfaithfulness（VPU）：一种错误编码虽然能成功执行并匹配预期 verdict 的失败模式。我们从理论上证明，对于这些具有欺骗性但有效的轨迹，结构性的、仅依赖 verdict 的验证启发式方法在检测上受限于随机猜测水平。为解决这一问题，我们提出 Generative Verification（GenV）：通过重新利用语言模型原生的词汇空间，将离线 Z3 等价性预言机蒸馏为一个无参考的、连续的参考等价性分数。通过决策投影 logit lens 和稀疏自编码器开展的机制分析表明，该生成式读出无需显式定位训练，即可原生提取精确的空间错误坐标。在实证上，我们的预言机挖掘验证器（GenV+HN）在参考等价性验证中达到0.961 AUROC，能在未见过的翻译器和差异显著的形式风格之间零样本泛化，并使智能体测试时计算分配的下游准确率提高11.3个百分点。
items.author_line: Vikash Singh, Debargha Ganguly, Aman Goel, Ali Torkamani, Xiaoxue Han, Joseph Lilien, Ferhat Erata, Vipin Chaudhary

items.title: An Open Recipe for IMO Gold: Training Nemotron for Olympiad Mathematics
items.abstract_or_text: We study how model post-training and test-time inference design affect natural-language proof generation for hard olympiad mathematics. Starting from Nemotron 3 Ultra, we train two specialist checkpoints using supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and evaluate checkpoint choice, verification, and refinement. Based on these findings, we present an open-model test-time-compute pipeline. The system operates entirely in natural language, with no formal prover, external tools, or internet access. Three Nemotron 3 Ultra checkpoints - the general-availability model and two post-trained specialists - power an iterative search that generates, verifies, and refines candidate proofs; a separate high-compute stage then selects each final submission. The system scored 30 out of 42 points at IMO 2026, reaching the gold-medal threshold. We release the two post-trained checkpoints as well as the training data, the training and inference code, the submitted solutions, and Nemotron-IMO-Bench, a new benchmark of 200 novel olympiad-level problems.
items.summary_zh: 该工作研究 Nemotron 的后训练和测试时推理设计，用迭代生成、核验、改写与高算力筛选来生成奥赛数学的自然语言证明。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它给出了模型、训练数据、代码、提交解答和新基准的公开承诺，并报告 IMO 2026 的30/42分；该系统不使用形式证明器，因此自然语言证明的正确性边界仍应与机器检查证明区分。
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究模型后训练和测试时推理设计如何影响高难度奥林匹克数学的自然语言证明生成。以 Nemotron 3 Ultra 为起点，我们使用监督微调和强化学习训练两个专门检查点，并评估检查点选择、验证和改进。基于这些发现，我们提出一条开放模型的测试时计算流水线。该系统完全以自然语言运行，不使用形式证明器、外部工具或互联网访问。三个 Nemotron 3 Ultra 检查点——通用可用模型和两个后训练专用模型——驱动迭代搜索，以生成、验证和改进候选证明；随后一个独立的高计算阶段为每道题选择最终提交。该系统在 IMO 2026 获得42分中的30分，达到金牌分数线。我们发布两个后训练检查点，以及训练数据、训练和推理代码、提交的解答和 Nemotron-IMO-Bench——一个包含200道新颖奥赛级问题的基准。
items.author_line: Ivan Moshkov, Stephen Ge, George Armstrong, Wei Du, Sadegh Mahdavi, Igor Gitman

items.title: BenchShield: Formal Model-Backed Instrumentation for Reward Integrity in LLM-Agent Evaluation Infrastructure
items.abstract_or_text: LM-agent benchmarks increasingly function as interactive evaluation infrastructure. Agents observe state, call tools, modify workspaces, submit artifacts, and receive rewards from outcome procedures. This interactivity makes evaluations vulnerable to reward hacking: an agent improves its measured score by exploiting the reward-relevant trajectory instead of solving the intended task. Existing defenses rely largely on task-specific patches, prompt instructions, or post-hoc detectors. They do not provide reusable evidence that a concrete run remained within its intended evaluation boundary. This paper presents BenchShield, a model-backed instrumentation layer for reward integrity in LLM-agent evaluation. BenchShield grounds detection in a finite lifecycle model of an evaluation's reward-relevant events. Within the benchmark infrastructure, two complementary analyses operate over this model. A static, phase-aware taint analysis exposes reward-hacking paths before a run. Its runtime counterpart uses infrastructure-side evidence to attribute concrete agent use and emit evidence-backed claims. We construct BenchShield Trajectories, a human-labeled corpus of 456 adjudicated trajectories from more than 31,000 public agent runs across three benchmarks. Compared with an agentic hackability scanner baseline on the same tasks and model, BenchShield improves full-chain recall from 23-94% to 77-100%, same-vector coverage from 16-56% to 43-78%, and reduces per-task cost by up to 65%. Its runtime analysis achieves 96% accuracy in detecting reward hacking from infrastructure-side evidence.
items.summary_zh: BenchShield以评测生命周期的有限状态模型为基础，结合阶段感知污点分析和运行时基础设施证据，检测智能体评测中的奖励操纵。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它关注评测本身是否可被奖励黑客攻击，并给出人工裁定轨迹及与基线的同任务比较；虽非数学解题基准，但与可验证智能体评测的形式化边界直接相关。
items.abstract_zh: LM 智能体基准日益成为交互式评测基础设施。智能体观察状态、调用工具、修改工作区、提交产物，并从结果程序中获得奖励。这种交互性使评测容易受到奖励黑客攻击：智能体通过利用与奖励相关的轨迹，而非解决预期任务，来提高其测得分数。现有防御主要依赖任务特定的补丁、提示指令或事后检测器。它们无法提供可复用的证据，证明一次具体运行始终处于其预期的评测边界内。本文提出 BenchShield：用于 LLM 智能体评测中奖励完整性的、以模型为基础的插桩层。BenchShield 将检测建立在评测中与奖励相关事件的有限生命周期模型之上。在基准基础设施内，两种互补分析在该模型上运行。静态的、阶段感知的污点分析在运行前暴露奖励黑客路径。其运行时对应方法使用基础设施侧证据来归因具体的智能体使用，并输出由证据支持的结论。我们构建 BenchShield Trajectories：一个人工标注的语料库，含456条经裁定轨迹，来自三个基准中超过31,000次公开智能体运行。与在相同任务和模型上使用的智能体式可黑客性扫描器基线相比，BenchShield 将全链路召回率从23–94%提升至77–100%，将同向量覆盖率从16–56%提升至43–78%，并将单任务成本最多降低65%。其运行时分析利用基础设施侧证据检测奖励黑客行为的准确率达到96%。
items.author_line: Shenghan Zheng, Zonglin Di, Yimin Liu, Kyoung Whan Choe, Jiankai Sun, Heguang Lin, Penghao Jiang, Yifeng He, Xiao Cheng, Jicheng Wang, Wenbo Chen, Alex Yates, Yinzhe Zhao, Bingran You, Yuan Gao, Ayush Munot, Shubham Gaur, Zhe Ye, Hao Wang, Xiangyi Li, Dawn Song, Christophe Hauser

items.title: Polyhedral Geometry of Time-to-First-Spike Neural Networks
items.abstract_or_text: We study the expressivity of spiking neural networks, which provide a natural framework for asynchronous, event-driven computation complementary to conventional feedforward neural networks. We consider the time-to-first-spike model in a setting for which the input-output map is continuous and piecewise linear, with affine pieces governed by causal feasibility constraints that determine which presynaptic spikes occur before a neuron fires. We first show that each neuron's firing time admits a maxout-like representation with exponentially many, highly constrained affine pieces. We then formalize causal regions as polyhedral regions with fixed causal sets and derive upper and lower bounds on the maximal number of causal regions in both shallow and multilayer feedforward spiking networks. Our theoretical and experimental results show that spiking networks can generate richer partitions of the input space than conventional feedforward ReLU networks.
items.summary_zh: 该工作将 time-to-first-spike 脉冲神经网络的因果区域表述为多面体区域，给出浅层和多层网络中因果区域数目的上下界。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供了关于特定脉冲网络模型表达性的明确理论对象和可检验界限，但并非对语言模型数学能力或证明助手的评测。
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究脉冲神经网络的表达能力；这类网络为异步、事件驱动计算提供了一个自然框架，与传统前馈神经网络互补。我们考虑 time-to-first-spike 模型，在该设定下，输入—输出映射是连续分段线性的，其仿射片段由因果可行性约束决定，而这些约束决定了哪些突触前脉冲发生在神经元放电之前。我们首先表明，每个神经元的放电时间都有一个类似 maxout 的表示，其中包含指数数量、但受到高度约束的仿射片段。随后，我们将因果区域形式化为具有固定因果集合的多面体区域，并推导出浅层和多层前馈脉冲网络中最大因果区域数目的上界和下界。我们的理论和实验结果表明，脉冲神经网络能够生成比传统前馈 ReLU 网络更丰富的输入空间划分。
